item.title: Bluesky wants to give you your own domain on the open web
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Bluesky says the process will still take 18-24 months, so don't expect your new, shortened 'bsky' handle any time soon.

item.title: Emmys will move from broadcast TV to Prime Video in 2027
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Non-Amazon Prime subscribers will be able to watch the awards show on the platform.

item.title: Mistral’s new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: French AI lab Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, a new large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals.

item.title: Pinterest’s AI now turns beauty Pins into action plans
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Pinterest’s new AI-powered Beauty Guides translate hair and nail Pins into salon terminology, with estimated costs, appointment times, and maintenance needs.

item.title: Uber is spending $2.3B to get into catering
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: It's the latest in a string of deals meant to grow Uber Eats into a food delivery behemoth.

item.title: Get all your questions answered at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: The full breakout session agenda revealed
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Get all of your scaling and tech questions answered at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Here's the full breakout session agenda, happening October 13-15 in San Francisco. Register now to join and save up to $100, and get a second pass at 50% off.

item.title: Paramount closes historic Warner Bros. merger to form Skydance
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The deal brings together two major streaming platforms, Paramount+ and HBO Max, along with networks including CBS, CNN, MTV, TBS, Comedy Central, and Food Network.

item.title: Glimpse wants to give hardware companies an X-ray view of every critical part
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Called Explore, Glimpse's new image processing software lets hardware makers speed up quality control checks using CT scanners.

item.title: Flai’s AI dealership software is booking 50,000 appointments per month
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Flai's revenue has grown 20x in a year, and the company just closed a $27 million Series A funding round.

item.title: Facebook tests going Reels-first in India
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Meta is testing a new Facebook UX in India that sends some users directly into full-screen video when they open the app, putting Reels front and center.

item.title: Type One Energy raised $200M to build a fusion power plant by 2034
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Type One Energy is betting that its lean approach to fusion power will get a power plant on the grid faster, and investors have rewarded it with $200 million.

item.title: Lucid Motors’ EV output falls to lowest level in almost 2 years
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The company is deliberately limiting production after years of struggling to find mass-market demand for its EVs.

item.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.

item.title: Etched fields funding offers at $40B+ valuation, sources say
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Just a couple of months after its last big raise, the AI chip startup is already being plied with investment offers at double or more its current value, sources tell TechCrunch.

item.title: After Factory’s public spat with Khosla, Menlo proudly invests
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Days after Vinod Khosla called Factory a struggling also-ran, Menlo has shown up with a check and a glowing blog post.

item.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Reflection is aiming Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations. The pitch is to build “AI factories,” a product that would let institutions build their own customized, local AI system by training Reflection’s AI models on their own proprietary data.

item.title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.

item.title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.

item.title: At 19, founder raises $11M for Ghost, maker of a $3,499 computer for personal AI
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Ghost's first product is Core, a personal computer designed specifically for AI agents that can take actions on a person's behalf.

item.title: Hot Girl Hotline is like ‘Dear Abby’ for the AI era
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Founded by two sisters, Hot Girl Hotline uses AI to give young women personalized dating and relationship advice, with an emphasis on safety and avoiding emotional dependency.
